scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling father and son work together on a wooden tool. Nearby, a sorrowful seated mother watches another boy hurry away beside an overturned basket of spilled grain.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing the contrast in Proverbs 10:1: a wise son gladdens his father, while a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler on a rocky riverbank pulls a struggling man from rushing water, beside an open chest spilling gold coins toward the torrent; a sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rescue illustrates Proverbs 10:2: wicked treasure cannot profit, while righteousness delivers from death.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man shares bread with a child at a table with two women, while another man reaches through a closed wooden gate toward the meal.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of provision and frustrated desire reflects Proverbs 10:3, where Yahweh does not let the righteous soul famish and casts away the desire of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit golden field, a farmer gathers wheat beside overflowing baskets while another man rests under an olive tree beside a nearly empty basket; stone homes and hills lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene illustrating Proverbs 10:4’s contrast between a slack hand and the fruitful work of the diligent.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden grain field, a young man gathers stalks into a sheaf while another sleeps under a tree beside loose harvested grain; hills and a village lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts gathering in summer with sleeping during harvest in Proverbs 10:5.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a woman places a leafy flower garland on the head of a seated man holding bread, while a child carries a basket of loaves. Nearby, a smiling man speaks to another man whose fist is held behind his back.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts a blessing on the head of the righteous with the verse's image of violence concealed by the mouth of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman speaks warmly to a child watering a flowering tree in a sunlit village garden. A decaying wooden marker rests among dry leaves nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a cherished memory, represented by a flourishing tree, with a decaying marker for the name of the wicked in Proverbs 10:7.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an older craftsman points to a piece of wood while a young apprentice listens; nearby, a gesturing man stumbles over a stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 10:8: the wise in heart receive commands, while a prating fool falls.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff walks along a sunlit road near a stone village, while another man emerges beside a stone wall from a winding path and villagers watch in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures walking securely in integrity and crooked ways becoming known, as described in Proverbs 10:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a man winks at a companion while a worried fruit seller watches; nearby, an animated speaker stumbles over a stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the winking eye that causes trouble and the prating fool who falls in Proverbs 10:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man speaks to listeners beside a flowing spring surrounded by greenery. Farther back, another man speaks while holding a clenched fist behind his back.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the righteous mouth as a well of life and contrasts it with violence concealed by the mouth of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a man and woman gesture toward each other while a seated neighbor spreads a woven cloth over a broken clay vessel and scattered shards.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:12: hatred stirs up strife, while love covers all sins.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a white-bearded elder speaks with an open hand to seated listeners beneath an olive tree. A man stands apart with his head lowered and his back partly turned, beside an upright wooden rod. Earthen vessels, foliage, and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the wise speaker with the verse’s wisdom on understanding lips, and the rod beside the other man with its image of correction for one lacking understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman and a man place rolled scrolls in a wooden chest while another man gestures open-mouthed beside a stack of tipping clay jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 10:14: the stored scrolls suggest knowledge kept by the wise, while the gesturing man and unstable jars suggest the nearness of destruction to a fool’s mouth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A prosperous man stands among stored provisions behind a fortified stone city wall, while a woman and two children sit beside a damaged dwelling with scant food outside the city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:15's contrast between wealth as a strong city and the hardship of poverty for the poor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village garden, a worker shares a basket of vegetables with a woman and two children. Nearby at a market stall, a hooded man offers coins to another man who reaches toward a vessel.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:16 by contrasting labor that nourishes life with money used to draw someone toward wrongdoing.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older guide points toward a green valley and winding path as one young traveler listens; another turns away along a rocky track.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the contrast in Proverbs 10:17 between keeping instruction on the way of life and refusing correction and going astray.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a smiling man holds a thorny branch behind his back while whispering to a woman. Another man reaches toward him, and a worried man watches from behind a low wall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the verse's concealed hatred, lying lips, and spreading of slander.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures while speaking to three seated listeners. A woman and a man look uneasy, while another man listens quietly with his hands folded.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the danger of many words and the wisdom of restraining one’s lips in Proverbs 10:19.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder speaks to a seated listener across a table bearing a shining silver bowl. A man holding a small pouch turns away in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a gentle conversation with bright silver to evoke the value of righteous speech, while the departing figure suggests the contrast with the heart of the wicked in Proverbs 10:20.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks to adults and children gathered beneath a fruit tree, with a basket of bread among them. A lone traveler walks toward a dry, rocky landscape in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 10:21: the gathering and bread suggest how righteous words nourish many, while the barren path hints at the danger of lacking wisdom.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling family rests beneath a fig tree among baskets of grapes, figs, and grain, with a stone house and sunlit hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene evokes the richness and absence of added sorrow in the blessing of Yahweh described in Proverbs 10:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a laughing man steps away from a tipped basket of fruit while a startled woman and a kneeling man gather the scattered produce.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a fool treating wrongdoing as sport with the response of a man of understanding, inspired by Proverbs 10:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man clutches a torn sack as grain spills onto the ground, while nearby a woman pours water into a smiling gardener’s cupped hands beside a flourishing garden and a sunlit village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the fear of the wicked coming upon him and the desire of the righteous being granted, as contrasted in Proverbs 10:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient clothing stands on a stone foundation beside a stone house, watching a whirlwind sweep past the scattered remains of a shelter in a sunlit valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the whirlwind passing and the righteous remaining on an enduring foundation, reflecting Proverbs 10:25.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man reclines beneath a tree beside a tied parcel. Nearby, a man winces while holding a cup, and a woman rubs her eye beside a smoky cooking fire.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 10:26: a lazy messenger is compared to vinegar on the teeth and smoke in the eyes of those who send him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with clasped hands looks upward beneath a flourishing olive tree. A winding sunlit path leads toward distant hills and a village, while a broken, withered sapling stands beside the path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a thriving tree and long path to suggest the days prolonged by fear of Yahweh, and a broken sapling to suggest the shortened years of the wicked in Proverbs 10:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, a smiling family shares bread and a basket of grapes with a seated neighbor, while a distressed man stands beside an overturned basket of scattered fruit.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the contrast in Proverbs 10:28 between the gladness of the righteous and the perishing expectation of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family rests inside a sturdy stone shelter beside a sunlit path while two men flee a collapsing stone structure in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the way of Yahweh as strength for the upright with destruction for workers of iniquity in Proverbs 10:29.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a staff stands on rocky ground beneath a fruiting olive tree beside a stone house, overlooking cultivated fields as four figures walk away along a distant road.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 10:30: the righteous remain secure while the wicked do not dwell in the land.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-bearded elder speaks to listeners beneath a fig tree laden with fruit, with a flowering shoot extending from his mouth. Nearby, a gardener holds pruning shears and a dry, twisted branch in a sunlit orchard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the wise speech of the righteous as fruitful growth and the cutting off of perverse speech as a pruned branch, echoing Proverbs 10:31.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a white-bearded elder speaks gently to a seated man. Nearby, a man whispers to a worried woman beside a curling thorny vine.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting gracious speech with the perverse speech described in Proverbs 10:32.
